title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・掴んだのは

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I'm back! I'm back! And I won the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: It was really something. The spectators and Hishiama were all saying that seeing me run got their hearts pounding… But you won't believe what happened next!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: City announced she was gonna run in the Japan Cup! And guess what she said!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: She mentioned how we run to become someone we love, and that she'll be waiting… It was like she was responding to what I said at summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: So it goes without saying that my next race is the Japan Cup! I'm gonna run with City!
